title: Renter's Insurance Minimum Liability and Community Liability Program Charge
content:
Each Apartment Home Lease floor plan sets the minimum personal liability limit a resident's renter's insurance must carry, and the monthly charge for enrollment in the community liability program while no qualifying proof of insurance is on file.

| Floor plan | Minimum personal liability limit (USD) | Community liability program charge per month |
|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 100000 | $13.50 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 100000 | $13.50 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 100000 | $13.50 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 100000 | $13.50 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 100000 | $13.50 |
| Penthouse Residence | 300000 | $13.50 |

- **Minimum personal liability limit** — the lowest personal liability limit of renter's insurance required on the floor plan: $100,000 on five floor plans and $300,000 on the Penthouse Residence.
- **Community liability program charge** — the monthly charge for enrollment in the community liability program while no qualifying proof of insurance is on file: $13.50 on every floor plan.

**Example (hypothetical).** A policy with a personal liability limit of $200,000 meets the floor plan minimum on a One-Bedroom Residence ($100,000) but not on a Penthouse Residence ($300,000). The limit is an example input.
